name: @office/domain-cost
description: Office cost/budget/commitment domain module (OFF-011): the canonical, provider-independent commercial model — one project-scoped Budget aggregate per project with immutable budget REVISIONS (full cost-item snapshots chained through supersedes), Commitment aggregates (purchase orders and subcontracts as canonical kinds) whose lines reference budget cost items through typed EntityId links, Invoice models referencing commitments through typed links with immutable lines, append-only payment references, and DETERMINISTIC committed-vs-budget / invoiced-vs-committed balance computation (pure functions of the recorded state — never stored counters) plus the cost-impact read model OFF-014's margin engine consumes. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, @office/events (the thin ledger-backed EventSink adapter) and @office/persistence (the SqlExecutor type of the mirrored EventSink port).
